snippet.description:
What does preparation look like when you learn directly from someone who has secured AIR 100?

Sattwik Satyakam Devta, AIR 100 in UPSC CSE 2025, visited LevelUp IAS for an exclusive strategy session with UPSC aspirants.

From understanding the preparation process to discussing strategy, planning and the realities of the UPSC journey, the session gave students an opportunity to learn directly from a recent UPSC achiever.

Watch the session and see what the right preparation system can look like from Day One.
